A09-42.note: Fixed after the audit's handoff (remote records worker, 2026-11-19). (1) Two-phase load: local entries after 0.4 s, the merged list when the host answers (test_a_slow_host_doesnt_hold_up_this_computers_history). (2) The search query is passed to RecordSync::list_remote. (3) The notice is the sync's own error with the reachable suffix, at the top, none on an empty list (the host is asked with the search and says why it couldn't be). (4) Transcribe again on a host-kept card fetches the recording first and shows Getting it from <host>… (transcribing a host-kept entry again fetches its recording first; the shared download is test_playback_fetch.cpp). (5) Host rows get Don't ask me again and respect the opt-out; a failed host delete is titled Delete History Entry (a host-kept entry is deleted there as the History prompts say; a host delete that fails says so under History's title). (6) HistoryManager reaches the provided RecordSyncControl (HistoryServices::find_record_sync; History tells the provided record sync what changed). Still different on purpose, under a17-retention: the copy on the host is kept (the prompts say so) and clearing History carries no note about the host, because RecordSync's delete and clear reach no host copy (clearing History has no note about the host).
